top_findings: Dead Sitelinks Searchbox endpoint in WebSite Schema (returns HTTP 404)
Systemic title tag double-branding causing SERP truncation across all 13 blog articles
Complete absence of BlogPosting / Article schema on all technical publications
Legacy WordPress paths in robots.txt on a Next.js / Vercel website
Missing individual P.Eng author bylines and credentials on safety-critical engineering analyses
quick_wins: Fix Next.js title.template in layout.tsx to eliminate double-branding and truncate titles under 60 chars
Remove broken potentialAction: SearchAction from WebSite schema
Clean up robots.txt to remove legacy WordPress directives and add explicit AI search crawler allowances
Deploy public/llms.txt to unlock AI Overview and answer engine indexing
Add security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options) in next.config.js

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 100% crawl success across 34 sitemap URLs with zero broken internal links
Consistent non-trailing slash canonical tags across all pages
HTTPS enforcement and modern HTTP/2 Vercel CDN delivery

findings.title: Legacy WordPress Directives in robots.txt on Next.js Site
findings.description: robots.txt disallows /wp-content/ and /wp-admin/ on a Next.js site and lacks rules for AI crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Update robots.txt with clean Next.js rules and explicit AI search permissions.

findings.title: Multi-Hop Redirect Chain on Non-Secure / Non-WWW Variants
findings.description: http://aegi.ca redirects through 2 hops (308 then 301) before reaching https://www.aegi.ca/.
findings.recommendation: Configure edge rules to redirect all HTTP and non-www variants directly in one 301 hop.

findings.title: Missing Standard Security Headers
findings.description: Lacks X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and Referrer-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Add standard headers in next.config.js headers() configuration.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Strong technical depth averaging 1,280 words per article
Rigorous citation of Canadian and provincial regulatory engineering standards (APEGA, CSA, API)
Zero keyword stuffing with natural readability

findings.title: Anonymous Engineering By-lines (E-E-A-T Deficiency)
findings.description: Safety-critical engineering guides lack named P.Eng author bylines, bios, and APEGA license references.
findings.recommendation: Add named author bios, professional designations, and team profile links.

findings.title: Internal Protocol Codes Injected into H1 Elements
findings.description: H1 tags include 'PROTOCOL #00X' prefixes, diluting target search keyword focus.
findings.recommendation: Separate protocol badges into independent UI spans above the H1.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Single H1 structure maintained across all pages
Clear geographic targeting for Alberta, Edmonton, and Calgary
Proper canonical tags pointing to self on all pages

findings.title: Systemic Title Tag Double-Branding & Character Length Bloat
findings.description: Blog titles exceed 100 characters due to double brand suffix appending in Next.js layout.
findings.recommendation: Update Next.js title.template to '%s | AEGI Engineering' and enforce <60 chars.

findings.title: Meta Description Character Length Exceeds Optimal Pixel Budget
findings.description: Multiple descriptions reach 180-207 characters, causing SERP snippet truncation.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite descriptions to 135-155 characters prioritizing value proposition and CTA.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: ProfessionalService and WebSite schema present on the site
BreadcrumbList schema implemented on all subpages
Local geographic and address details included in schema

findings.title: Dead Internal Search Target in Sitelinks Searchbox (SearchAction)
findings.description: WebSite schema declares /search?q={search_term_string} which returns HTTP 404.
findings.recommendation: Remove potentialAction: SearchAction until an active search route is implemented.

findings.title: Missing BlogPosting / Article Schema on Blog Posts
findings.description: All 13 blog articles completely lack Article or BlogPosting JSON-LD markup.
findings.recommendation: Inject dynamic BlogPosting schema in app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx.

findings.title: Redundant Global Schema Duplication
findings.description: WebSite and ProfessionalService are re-injected on every page as disconnected blocks.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate into an interconnected @graph structure using @id references.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Sub-250ms TTFB powered by Vercel Edge caching and Next.js SSG
Near-zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS < 0.05)
Fast DOM Complete times under 1.5 seconds

findings.title: Unconstrained 3840px Image Variant Requests for Hero Logo
findings.description: Logo asset requests 3840px wide variation even on mobile viewports.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit sizes attribute to next/image components.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO & Agentic)
what_works: Server-rendered HTML accessible to AI bots without mandatory JS execution
Strong entity mentions (APEGA, CSA Z662, Edmonton, Calgary)

findings.title: Missing llms.txt and Machine-Readable LLM Index
findings.description: /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt return 404, hindering answer engine citation indexing.
findings.recommendation: Publish public/llms.txt outlining services, accreditations, and regulatory bodies.

findings.title: Absence of Direct Definition Snippets for AI Overview Ingestion
findings.description: Technical pages lack concise 40-60 word definitive answer summaries for featured snippets.
findings.recommendation: Add quick-summary definition blocks below headings on key engineering topics.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 0 broken image links across all crawled pages
All images have descriptive alt text
WebP format utilized via Next.js image optimizer

findings.title: Missing Explicit Dimensions on Select Static SVG Assets
findings.description: A few inline decoration SVGs lack explicit width/height attributes.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit width/height or aspect-ratio CSS to all SVG wrappers.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes & Compliance (Week 1)
items: Remove invalid potentialAction SearchAction from WebSite schema to eliminate 404 search penalties
Fix Next.js title.template double-branding in layout.tsx to resolve title truncation across all 13 blog posts
Replace legacy WordPress robots.txt with clean Next.js directives and explicit AI crawler allowances
Eliminate double redirect hop on http://aegi.ca via direct 301 edge rules

phases.name: Phase 2: Structured Data & Schema Graph (Weeks 2-3)
items: Implement dynamic BlogPosting schema on all 13 blog articles with headline, author, and dates
Consolidate separate JSON-LD blocks into an interconnected @graph linked via @id references
Deploy public/llms.txt with concise service catalog and APEGA licensing credentials
Configure standard security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options) in next.config.js

phases.name: Phase 3: E-E-A-T & Authority Signals (Month 2)
items: Add named P.Eng author bylines, professional bios, and licensing numbers to all engineering guides
Create dedicated engineer profile pages linked to LinkedIn and provincial associations (APEGA/EGBC)
Restructure blog H1 headings to remove 'PROTOCOL #00X' prefixes into separate badge components
Add 45-60 word 'Quick Summary' definition boxes to capture Google AI Overviews and Perplexity snippets

phases.name: Phase 4: Optimization, Performance & Monitoring (Ongoing)
items: Add explicit sizes attributes to next/image components to eliminate oversized 3840px asset requests
Rewrite meta descriptions exceeding 160 characters to optimize click-through rates in mobile SERPs
Conduct bi-weekly SEO drift monitoring to ensure Next.js build deploys do not regress metadata
